name: L4 · 这家宾馆跟别的都不一样
titleCn: 这家宾馆跟别的都不一样
titleEn: This hotel is unlike any other

intro.cn: 在王一飞家客厅，杨同乐和王一飞在聊天儿。
intro.en: In Wang Yifei's living room, Yang Tongle and Wang Yifei were chatting.

questions.q: 王一飞和杨同乐在说什么？
杨同乐觉得草原怎么样？

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 这个假期咱们去哪儿玩吧。
lines.en: How about going somewhere for a vacation？

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 好啊，你想去哪儿，咱们就去哪儿。
lines.en: Sure, we can go wherever you'd like.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 你喜欢海，找个海边住几天，怎么样？
lines.en: You like the sea—how about staying by the coast for a few days？

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 现在去海边有点儿冷。
lines.en: It's a bit too cold to go to the seaside now.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 那去草原吧？草原一点儿也不冷。
lines.en: Then let's go to the grasslands. It's not cold there at all.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 这个主意好！我好久没骑马了。
lines.en: Great idea! I haven't ridden a horse in ages.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 对，在草原上骑马、吃羊肉、看月亮，一定很有意思。
lines.en: Exactly! Riding horses, eating mutton, and watching the moon on the grasslands must be wonderful.

postQuestions.q: 王一飞为什么不想去海边？
王一飞为什么觉得去草原好？
他们在草原上可以做什么？

intro.cn: 在王一飞家客厅，杨同乐和王一飞在聊天儿。
intro.en: In Wang Yifei's living room, Yang Tongle and Wang Yifei were chatting.

questions.q: 王一飞觉得这次出去玩要带什么东西？

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 出去玩的机票买好了吗？
lines.en: Have you booked the plane tickets for our trip？

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 买好了。星期六上午十点一刻起飞。
lines.en: Yes, I have. The flight departs at a quarter past ten on Saturday morning.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 宾馆也选好了吗？
lines.en: Have you chosen the hotel as well？

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 是的，这家宾馆很特别，跟别的都不一样，一出门就能看见牛和羊！
lines.en: Yes. This hotel is really special—it's unlike any other. The moment you step outside, you can see cows and sheep！

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 太好了！你看看要带什么东西？
lines.en: Perfect! Let's check what we need to take.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 我们不用带太多东西，别忘了拿上新买的相机。
lines.en: We don't need to bring too much. Just don't forget the new camera we bought.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 一定不会忘带的。我现在就去准备行李。
lines.en: I definitely won't. I'll go pack right now.

postQuestions.q: 他们什么时候坐飞机出去玩？
王一飞选的宾馆怎么样？
杨同乐说一定不会忘带什么？

intro.cn: 在机场，杨同乐和王一飞走出来，跟他们预约的司机兼导游见面。
intro.en: At the airport, Yang Tongle and Wang Yifei came out and met the driver-guide they had booked.

questions.q: 他们到宾馆后先做什么？

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.cn: 欢迎你们！我是你们的司机，我姓李，叫我小李就可以。
lines.en: Welcome! I'm your driver. My last name is Li—just call me Xiao Li.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 您好！不好意思，飞机晚点了，让您久等了。
lines.en: Hello! I'm sorry our flight was delayed, and you've been waiting for a long time.

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.cn: 没关系。除了这个行李箱以外，还有别的东西吗？
lines.en: That's all right. Besides this suitcase, do you have anything else？

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 还有一个包，我自己拿就可以。
lines.en: Just one more bag—I can carry it myself.

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.cn: 车在一层，请跟我来。
lines.en: The car is on the first floor. Please follow me.

lines.speaker: 杨同乐
lines.cn: 我们住的宾馆离机场远吗？
lines.en: Is our hotel far from the airport？

lines.speaker: 小李
lines.cn: 不远，三十分钟就能到。两位到了可以先休息休息，晚饭的时候我叫你们。
lines.en: Not far—we'll get there in about thirty minutes. Once you arrive, you can take a short rest first. I'll call you when it's time for dinner.

words.en: (of a train, ship, etc.) be late

intro.cn: 在宾馆房间，王一飞在写日记。
intro.en: In the hotel room, Wang Yifei was writing in her diary.

questions.q: 飞机晚点后，司机做什么了？

lines.cn: 今天是我们旅游的第一天。
lines.en: Today is the first day of our trip.

lines.cn: 我们很早就起床去机场了，没想到飞机晚点了。
lines.en: We got up very early to go to the airport, but to our surprise, the flight was delayed.

lines.cn: 我们到的时候，天已经黑了，但是司机小李一直在机场等我们，一点儿也没着急。
lines.en: By the time we arrived, it was already dark. Fortunately, our driver, Xiao Li, had been waiting for us at the airport all along and wasn't the least bit impatient.

lines.cn: 他特别热情，路上给我们介绍了很多东西，还准备了水果。
lines.en: He was extremely warm and friendly, telling us a lot about the local area along the way and even preparing some fruit for us.

lines.cn: 宾馆的房间跟我想的一样漂亮，又大又干净，我非常满意。
lines.en: The hotel room is just as beautiful as I imagined—spacious and clean. I'm very satisfied with it.

postQuestions.q: 王一飞为什么觉得小李很热情？

grammar.note: 固定格式“一……也/都＋不/没……”表示完全否定。有时候“一＋量词”还可以用“一点儿”来表示；当谓语是形容词时，通常用“一点儿也/都＋不/没＋形容词”。
grammar.noteEn: The fixed pattern “一…也/都＋不/没…” expresses complete negation. Sometimes “一+Measure Word” can be replaced by “一点儿”. When the predicate is an adjective, “一点儿也/都＋不/没+Adjective” is commonly used to express complete negation.

items.en: She doesn't want to buy a single piece of clothing.

items.c: 我一个中国电影也没看过。
items.en: I haven't seen a single Chinese movie.

items.c: 我一点儿东西也不想吃。
items.en: I don't want to eat anything at all.

items.c: 他对打球一点儿兴趣也没有。
items.en: He isn't the least bit interested in ball games.
The grasslands aren't cold at all.
They weren't worried in the least.

practice.cn: 我们上个月搬家了，______。（认识）
这个星期我太忙了，______。（时间）

grammar.note: 比较句“A跟B一样”表示A和B比较后，结果相同。“一样”的后面可以用形容词表示比较的某一方面，基本结构：A跟B一样＋形容词。否定形式是在“一样”的前面加“不”。
grammar.noteEn: The comparative sentence “A跟B一样” indicates that A and B are the same after comparison. “一样” can be followed by an adjective to specify the aspect being compared. Basic structure: A跟B一样+Adjective. In the negative form, “不” is placed before “一样”.

items.c: 这家宾馆跟别的都不一样。
items.en: This hotel is unlike any other.

items.c: 他买的新手机跟我的一样。
items.en: The new phone he bought is the same as mine.

items.c: 这个房间跟那个房间一样大。
items.en: This room is as big as that one.

grammar.cn: 固定格式“除了……（以外），……都/还/也……”
grammar.note: “除了……（以外），……都……”表示在一个范围内，排除一部分，其他的都存在相同的情况，其中“以外”可以省略。“除了……（以外），……还/也……”表示排除一部分，补充其他的，句子的主语放在句首，或者放在“还/也”的前面。
grammar.noteEn: “除了…（以外），…都…” indicates that within a certain scope, one part is excluded while all the others share the same situation; “以外” can be omitted. “除了…（以外），…还/也…” excludes one part and adds others; the subject is placed at the beginning of the sentence or before “还/也”.

items.c: 除了我以外，大家都在玩手机。
items.en: Everyone except me is playing on their phones.

items.c: 除了这个汉字，别的汉字我都会写。
items.en: Except for this character, I can write all the others.

items.c: 除了这个行李箱以外，还有别的东西吗？
items.en: Besides this suitcase, do you have anything else？

items.c: 除了唱歌以外，他也喜欢跳舞。
items.en: Besides singing, he also likes dancing.

classroomActivity.description: 四人一组，设计一个假期旅游计划。计划内容包括旅游的地点、交通方式、住宿安排、每日活动等，并说明这样设计的原因。
classroomActivity.descriptionEn: Work in groups of four. Design a vacation travel plan that includes the destination, means of transportation, accommodation arrangements and daily activities, and explain the reasons for your design.
